knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The procedure requires checking equipment before moving it, storing products upright and labelled in approved locations, and never blocking fire equipment or exits.
When authority, access or a storage location is unclear, the lesson says to pause and escalate. The worked example rejects an unapproved storage place and reports the capacity issue.
The workplace procedure says to store products upright in labelled containers within approved locked or restricted locations, with the SDS accessible.

practicalCriteria: Demonstrates safe movement, contamination segregation, compliant site storage and fault isolation.

passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 3: Keep clean and contaminated tools separate, and segregate bathroom and food-area supplies.
Record of procedure step 7: Log and isolate any equipment fault.
Record of procedure step 8: If a task exceeds training, consent, safe access or the agreed scope, pause it, report promptly and document the reason.
